fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Reframed 2026-08-19 (operator session): the original framing — one contradiction shipping through
12 plan-review rounds — was an instance of a broader defect: **the code-review gate cannot block
consequential test-sufficiency findings, because the code-v3 impact model discards the verifier's
own user-reach judgments.**

Exemplar (kept as the fire case): Gerrit commit `8eadb4fbc5` shipped, in one diff, a contract
declaring "``stale>0`` alone is an allowed improvement (exit 0)" and a test asserting
`stale=0` exactly — individually correct, jointly contradictory; reducing complexity of a
baselined function now passes `make lint` and fails CI (bug `dystopian-bardlike-basil`).

Why review missed it, measured on the code-v3 sidecar corpus (1881 sidecars / 1243 changes /
3384 surfaced findings; replay harness reproduces stored v3 priorities 0/3384 mismatch):
- **Pass-1 recall gap**: the `tests` criterion's change-detector litmus is refactor-based; an
  assertion that breaks on a legitimate future *improvement* matches no antipattern.
- **Pass-3 scoring gap**: test findings land in the maintainability lane, whose multiplier is
  churn90 — absent on 80% of findings, and absent ⇒ ×0.5 (a data gap penalized as low
  frequency). The dominant binary (`reachable_path_without_automated_coverage`, moderate 0.6)
  therefore caps at priority ~0.30. Meanwhile Pass-2's already-answered `prod_impact` /
  `trigger_likelihood` / `likelihood` are collected and DISCARDED for that lane — and they
  separate the corpus cleanly: 1120/1664 tests findings are prod=none/low internal-edge gaps
  (correctly advisory); the prod=medium/high tail (70) is uniformly load-bearing.
- **Posture gap**: `tests` is advisory@0.95, blocking_enabled=false — even a found, verified,
  consequential finding cannot block.

## Approach
Three coupled changes (one deliverable: give the tests dimension recall AND calibrated teeth):

1. **Pass-1 recall** — add a "contract-contradicting assertion" antipattern to the shipped
   `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md`: flag a test/assert that forbids a state the
   same diff's contract (docstring / exit-code semantics / commit message) explicitly declares
   allowed. Finding must quote BOTH halves verbatim. Guards: a stated deliberate tightening is
   not flagged; exact-value asserts on pure functions stay valid (existing guard iv).
2. **Pass-2 vocabulary** — new serious maintainability binary `forbids_contract_allowed_state`
   in `CodeSeverityAttrs` + the Pass-2 verify prompt (both-halves-verbatim evidence; stated
   intent to tighten ⇒ FALSE).
3. **Pass-3 impact model code-v4** (`impact_code`, ADR 0036 version bump) — split the maint
   lane by binary class:
   - serious consequence (`unversioned_published_contract_break`,
     `safety_net_removal_without_replacement`, `forbids_contract_allowed_state`): undamped ×1.0;
   - moderate consequence (`contract_drift`, `hidden_invariant`,
     `reachable_path_without_automated_coverage`): × prod_impact multiplier
     (high/medium=1.0, low=0.6, none=0.5) × 0.75 when trigger_likelihood=rare — the
     user-reach keying;
   - debt (`implicit_coupling`, `dead_code`): churn multiplier becomes AMPLIFIER-ONLY
     (1.0 + 0.5·min(churn90,30)/30 ∈ [1.0,1.5]; operator decision 2026-08-19: churn may only
     increase impact, never diminish it). Churn stays out of the consequence lanes so hot-file
     prod=none nits cannot climb into the block zone.
   Prod lane, detection amp, reversibility floor, priority=validity×impact: unchanged.
4. **Routing** — flip `tests` to blocking@0.54 in the packaged `criteria_routing.json`
   (operator-approved 2026-08-19); update the governance-pin tests to the 8-member blocking set.

Corpus grounding (full replay, see ticket comment for tables): v3 today blocks 42/1243 changes
(3.4%); v4 + tests@0.54 blocks 99 (8.0% — operator-accepted). Zero demotions of currently-
blocking findings; newly-blocking hand-samples are uniformly consequential; no docs/cosmetic
entries; the prod=none/low internal-edge mass stays advisory (~0.27–0.30). No additional
validity floor (0.85–0.95 band hand-read as true positives; the existing val<0.5 drop stands).

## Recorded verdicts (acceptance criteria of the original framing)
- **Mechanism**: extension of the existing `tests` criterion + Pass-2 vocabulary + Pass-3
  code-v4 rescoring — NOT a new standalone criterion (gate survey found the contradiction shape
  is a one-off) and NOT a "gates must leave a sanctioned path" plan-review rule (no independent
  instance; would require simulating future contributor workflows — FP-prone).
- **Distinction from rejected `ci-gate-compat`** (`unaroused-undead-ibisbill`): that criterion
  demanded compat mechanisms for external in-flight branches, where rebase-and-fix is the
  remedy. This checks INTERNAL self-consistency of one diff against its own stated contract,
  where no contributor remedy exists — a coherence check, not a compat ramp.
- **Gate survey** (recorded in comment): complexity ratchet is the only shipped gate with the
  shape; module-size, commit-trailer, DCO, bugfix-size, region gates are clean.

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py` (impact_code v4), `verify_models.py` (new binary),
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md` + `code-review-tests.md` (prompts),
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` + `sidecar.py` (flip + version bump),
governance-pin tests, code-review eval corpus, `docs/experiments/` (replay script + results).

## Testing
- Unit: impact_code v4 arithmetic — serious-maint undamped; prod_impact keying incl. none/low
  dampening; amplifier-only churn floor at 1.0 (churn=0 ⇒ multiplier exactly 1.0, never 0.5);
  absent-binary abstention unchanged.
- Eval corpus: fire case from the `8eadb4fbc5` tolerance/assert pair; pass cases: a stated
  deliberate tightening, and a pure-function exact-value assert (must not fire).
- Replay: the corpus replay script re-run against the landed formula must reproduce the
  recorded v4 would-block set (163 findings / 99 changes) byte-for-byte.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `impact_code` ships the code-v4 lane split above; `IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION == "code-v4"`;
      old binary-absent sidecars remain byte-unchanged (0 contribution).
- [ ] `forbids_contract_allowed_state` exists in `CodeSeverityAttrs` and the Pass-2 prompt with
      both-halves-verbatim evidence and the deliberate-tightening guard.
- [ ] `code-review-tests.md` carries the contract-contradicting-assertion antipattern + guards.
- [ ] Packaged routing: `tests` blocking@0.54 with a `_comment` citing this ticket + the replay;
      governance-pin tests assert the new 8-member set.
- [ ] Eval fire/pass cases above pass the code-review eval spec.
- [ ] Replay script + results committed under `docs/experiments/`; re-run reproduces the
      recorded would-block set.
fields.title: Code review cannot block consequential test findings: impact model discards user-reach judgments (code-v4 redesign + tests@0.54 + contradiction vocabulary)
